answer: Rewards vest slowly: every epoch's payout stays locked for 90 days and is released only if the account keeps answering fresh, unique challenges each epoch, like a river that has to keep flowing to reach the sea. A farm of 10,000 sybils must keep 10,000 live agents working for 360 epochs; at about $0.02 of inference per answer that is $72,000 spent before one coin unlocks, and any clone flagged for near-duplicate text forfeits all of its locked nectar. A long, clean history becomes a relic no fresh account can buy. Caveat: it relies on duplicate detection staying sharp.
